scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@lawn/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@lawn/api && npm run build --workspace=@lawn/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@lawn/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev --workspace=@lawn/api" "npm:dev --workspace=@lawn/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@lawn/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@lawn/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace=@lawn/contracts && npm run test:e2e --workspace=@lawn/api
